summary: F1 is fixed: rendering now reads the handoff manifest through prepare. The Forge gesture map replaces the approved Adventurer inset with classmate cut-outs.
blocking_findings: F2 [Blocker] review-c: The new ForgeArt adapter changes the approved gesture inset to the handoff's classmate cut-outs. `manifestToForgeInput()` groups every `cutouts/<classmate>/<gesture>.png` into `gestures` and assigns the `listen` classmate frames to `idle` (scripts/prepare.mjs:283-305). `prepareWithManifest()` installs those maps into `spec.forge` (lines 353-376). `GestureCard` then selects `spec.forge.gestures[line.gesture]` or `spec.forge.idle` (src/GestureInset.tsx:53-74), and `ForgeFigure` cycles through those frames (lines 123-145). This violates the strategy requirement to keep the approved Adventurer gesture inset and change only the actor row (test-strategy.md:127). Do not accept Phase 2 frames until this contract is restored.
